AMIT RANA

EMAIL: Amit2021sd@gmail.com MOBILE: +91 - 9970241200

Results-driven AI Project Manager with 18+ years of experience leading global technology programs and delivering enterprise-scale software solutions, including recent experience managing AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, prompt engineering initiatives, and AI quality assurance. Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, AI model evaluation, Responsible AI, and data quality governance. Proven ability to manage AI program delivery, annotation operations, vendor coordination, productivity metrics, and stakeholder communication using Agile methodologies.

PROFILE SUMMARY

❖ Accomplished Senior Program Management Leader with 18+ years of success driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across Telecom, Payments, Banking, and Digital Ecosystems, delivering high-impact programs aligned with strategic business objectives and operational excellence.

❖ Expertise in leading large-scale global delivery portfolios involving Agile transformation, PMO governance, OSS/BSS modernization,

payment platform integration, API enablement, and mission-critical enterprise systems across geographically distributed teams.

❖ High level proficiency in Agile project delivery using Jira, including backlog management, workflow configuration, sprint planning, sprint

tracking, dashboard reporting, and release management

❖ Results-oriented Technology Executive with proven capability in managing multimillion-dollar programs, steering cross-functional teams of 40+ resources, optimizing delivery governance, and ensuring seamless execution through robust risk, dependency, and stakeholder management frameworks.

❖ Expertise in leading AI projects in AI data annotation, Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation, Generative AI, and AI quality assurance. ❖ Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Responsible AI,

Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and AI model lifecycle management

❖ Specialized in Payments & Financial Technology domains with hands-on leadership across ISO 8583, ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, transaction lifecycle management, regulatory compliance, and high-volume transaction processing platforms for global enterprises. ❖ Strategic transformation professional recognized for driving AI-led automation, process optimization, enterprise modernization, and

❖

data-driven decision-making initiatives that enhance delivery efficiency, customer experience, and organizational scalability. Influential leader with strong expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery, executive stakeholder engagement, enterprise release governance, and customer-centric program execution, consistently delivering complex technology initiatives within scope, timeline, and budget.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Enterprise Program Transformation

AI Workflow Automation, Prompt Engineering

Risk, Compliance & Escalation Management

AI Project & Program Management

Enterprise Stakeholder Governance

Technology Delivery & Execution Excellence

Generative AI & AI Model Evaluation

Large-Scale Delivery Management

Agile Release & Sprint Governance

EDUCATION

CERTIFICATIONS

❖ Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification – Project

Bachelor’s Degree (Mechanical Engineering) – Bhagalpur College of Engineering – Completed in 2001

Management Institute (PMI)

❖ Certified Scrum Master (CSM) – Scrum Alliance ❖ HCIA 5G Certification – Huawei ❖

ISTQB Certified Tester – Qualifications Board

International Software Testing

WORK EXPERIENCE

Mercor| Redmond, WA – Technical Project Manager | Sep 2026 till date ❖ Managed AI data annotation projects supporting the training and evaluation of Large Language Models. ❖ Coordinated distributed teams of annotators, reviewers, and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality labeled datasets. ❖ Established annotation guidelines, quality metrics, calibration sessions, and review workflows to improve dataset consistency. ❖ Led LLM evaluation activities including response ranking, factuality verification, hallucination detection, instruction-following assessment,

reasoning evaluation, and safety reviews.

❖ Managed prompt engineering initiatives for benchmarking multiple foundation models including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs. ❖ Oversaw dataset creation for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference ranking, and reinforcement learning workflows. ❖ Monitored annotation productivity, quality KPIs, throughput, and reviewer agreement using structured dashboards. ❖ Worked closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, product managers, and data scientists to improve model performance. ❖ Managed Agile sprint planning, backlog prioritization, stakeholder communication, risk management, and project reporting.

TMO| Redmond, WA – Technical Project Manager | March 2022 – Sep 2026 ❖ Spearheaded end-to-end carrier certification and device onboarding programs for T-Mobile, driving product roadmap execution, backlog

prioritization, and requirement engineering for seamless delivery of certified telecom solutions.

❖ Extensive experience in creation of Test Strategy, Test Plans, Test Scripts, and execution for Payments applications. ❖ Participated in BRD (Business Requirement Document) and FSD (Functional Specification Document) reviews to ensure complete test

coverage and business alignment.

❖ Provided regular status reporting, defect triage management, test summaries, and testing traceability across project lifecycles. ❖ Conducted meetings and review sessions with Operations teams and key stakeholders to discuss testing progress, risks, and issue resolution. ❖ Strong Agile testing experience including backlog grooming sessions, sprint planning, sprint execution, and daily SCRUM participation. ❖ Collaborated closely with Line of Business, Risk & Compliance teams, and Technology partners across Operations. ❖ Hands-on experience in Banking and Financial Services domain with strong focus on Payments Testing. ❖ ❖ Payments Investigations, Wire Transfers, ACH Payments, Real-Time Payments (RTP), SWIFT Messaging ❖ Straight Through Processing (Strong understanding and practical experience in: ❖ Test Plans Test Cases Test Procedures Test Scripts Expected Results Validation Experience working on UAT, SIT, and NRT testing for: ❖ ACI Worldwide Projects (MTS) Volante Products (VolPay/EPE, Message Gateway) PEGA / Smart Investigate ❖ SWIFT (MT Messages, Gateway, FIN, ISO 20022) Risk Control System (RCS) RGW Dodd-Frank Compliance Voice Response Unit (VRU)

In-depth knowledge of:

Additional Pointers: ❖ Directed large-scale device certification ecosystems for telecom carriers by integrating RF, protocol, and conformance testing workflows

across multi-lab environments to ensure end-to-end validation integrity.

❖ Orchestrated enterprise vendor ecosystem management, coordinating with global test equipment providers to resolve critical tooling,

❖

scripting, and compatibility issues impacting certification timelines. Implemented structured resource forecasting and capacity planning models to optimize utilization of cross-functional teams across hardware, firmware, software, and QA engineering streams.

❖ Led structured knowledge transfer and technical enablement programs for distributed teams, ensuring standardized delivery practices and

accelerated onboarding of new consultants and engineers.

❖ Established structured SOW governance and commercial delivery alignment processes, ensuring clarity in scope definition, contractual

adherence, and controlled execution of enterprise engagements.

AT&T| Redmond, WA – Scrum Master | May 2019 – February 2022 ❖ Led large-scale OSS/BSS transformation programs covering billing, provisioning, and transaction workflows, driving enterprise-wide digital

modernization and operational efficiency.

❖ Directed global cross-functional teams across business and technology domains, ensuring alignment on program objectives, governance

frameworks, and delivery milestones.

❖ Managed full program financial lifecycle including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and ROI optimization to ensure strong financial

governance and value realization.

❖ Executed Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies in hybrid delivery environments while serving as Scrum Master for multiple enterprise

Agile teams across concurrent releases.

❖ Led enterprise data and integration initiatives including EDW, MDM, API integrations, and post-merger system consolidation ensuring

seamless interoperability and compliance.

Sungard – Senior Project Manager | January 2016 – April 2019 ❖ Delivered end-to-end payment platforms using ISO 8583 and ISO 20022 standards, enabling secure, scalable, and high-volume transaction

processing systems.

❖ Managed cross-border and domestic payment flows including SWIFT (MT103, MT202) and SEPA (pain.001, pacs.008), ensuring compliance,

accuracy, and seamless settlement.

❖ Applied Agile planning, bottom-up estimation, and resource forecasting to ensure predictable delivery timelines and optimal utilization of

project resources.

❖ Collaborated with engineering and API teams to ensure seamless integration and orchestration of payment transactions across enterprise

systems and gateways.

❖ Resolved complex payment failures including duplicates, timeouts, and formatting errors, improving system reliability and transaction

success rates.

❖ Strong exposure to API-level integrations, including REST API coordination, Swagger/API documentation review, request-response

validation, integration testing support, defect triaging, and end-to-end system integration management.

❖ Experience collaborating with Development, QA, Product Owners, HR teams, and business stakeholders to drive project execution, resource

planning, defect management, and delivery governance.

Telefonica – Defect Manager / Test Architect | December 2014 – December 2015 ❖ Led end-to-end defect lifecycle management across mobile (2G–5G) and enterprise systems ensuring structured tracking, prioritization, and

timely resolution of critical issues.

❖ Supported product enhancements across claims, payments, authorization workflows, and benefits systems ensuring smooth delivery of

customer-facing features.

❖ Managed Agile backlog, roadmap, and release planning using Jira and Confluence to ensure transparency, governance, and delivery

alignment.

❖ Collaborated with UX, QA, engineering, and business teams to ensure requirement clarity, design validation, and synchronized execution of

❖

releases. Identified risks and delivery bottlenecks proactively and implemented mitigation strategies to ensure on-time and quality-driven delivery outcomes.

❖ Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new domains, understand complex business workflows, stakeholder expectations, compliance

requirements, and drive successful project outcomes in Agile environments.

Datamatics – Test Lead | August 2008 – November 2014 ❖ Defined comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, and system testing ensuring high-quality delivery

aligned with business requirements.

❖ Led end-to-end testing activities for healthcare insurance applications, including policy administration, member enrollment, claims

processing, provider management, and customer portals.

❖ Managed a team of 8–12 QA engineers across onsite and offshore locations, ensuring timely delivery of testing milestones.

❖ Developed test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on business requirements and functional specifications. ❖ Coordinated Functional, System Integration (SIT), Regression, User Acceptance (UAT), and End-to-End testing across multiple releases. ❖ Collaborated with business analysts, developers, product owners, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve production issues. ❖ Managed defect lifecycle using Jira/ALM, conducted defect triage meetings, and ensured timely resolution of critical issues. ❖ ❖ Automated regression test suites using Selenium WebDriver and integrated automated execution into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. ❖ Validated REST/SOAP APIs using Postman and SOAP UI and performed backend database validation using SQL. ❖ Generated daily status reports, quality metrics, test execution dashboards, and release readiness reports for senior management. ❖ Mentored QA team members on testing best practices, Agile processes, and quality standards. ❖

Implemented risk-based testing approaches to improve test coverage while reducing execution time.

Improved release quality by reducing production defects through proactive risk identification, root cause analysis, and continuous process improvements
